posts.author: avp2master
posts.title: Cop reqruitment.
posts.html:
Alright, i'm getting tired of fail cops rkoing and rdming for weapons, and the admins banning and blacklisting them isn't enough. There should be a system that when if you want to be a cop, you don't just press F1, click cop and BOOM, you're a cop, you can do anything if the admins aren't around.   

   Instead, we should make it that if you want to become a cop, you need to apply for it at the forums.

That way, mingebags can't really abuse cop. And if they do, they should be blacklisted. I am sick and tired of cops that don't rp, always break nlr, and rdm.

posts.author: Jack the Stripper
posts.title: A few suggestions to help RP
posts.html:
I decided to put a few suggestions into this thread instead of spamming the forum...ok here we go:

no.1 is an idea for helping out with the problem with abusing police abuse:

Don't allow people to just press F1 and become police officer.
Instead, give the authority to accept police officers to the mayor, so that the mayor have to accept people as police officers. this way the mayor don't have to worry about if his police officers are around pissing his citizens off, since he has already tested their capabilities in RP...and it will add some necessary RP to the server. Of course there should be some solution for the mayor's safety while there is no police officers on.
like, make two different levels of officers, like have the regular officers player limit be 3 or 4 or around that area(this level should be joinable through F1), and have another level called
"Formal officer" or something like that.(only joinable by permission by the mayor)
And have some sort of system to prevent citizens from RDM'ing the mayor if he doesn't accept right away...ill let you think this one out.

no.2 is about the hostage rules in the F1 menu:
i would like an accurate explenation for what is and what is not a reasonable amount to demand from a hostage(depending on the class they are)

no.3 has to do with the rule of yelling "raid" before raiding:
i dont think yelling this should be enough reason to raid the nexus or even a room. I think that there should be actual RP involved making it obvious that something is going to happen.

this was all of my suggestions for now.
if you like em, thanks, if you dont, I would think you have your reasons, so please tell.
